Adaptable. Toolkit problems will involve different areas of computer science and machine learning skills, sometimes within the same problem. You can context shift depending on the problem and can adjust if new problems and/or requirements arise requiring rethinking the approach to solving a problem.
  
  
Detail oriented. Toolkit is focused on making tools that just work. Skills to Stand Out. You like to code and have interest in learning new technologies. You find it exciting to explore and/or improve libraries to help you solve a problem. Lifelong engineering. Curiosity about machine learning. You know a few things about learning algorithms, data preprocessing strategies, or some other interesting areas of machine learning that can help create more integrated and robust software solutions.
